purpose: Teach: フリーズ/プロトタイプ/ゲラ/内野/地場/からくり/ペンネーム/中高生

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、画面のフリーズ対策を強化しろ
lines.en: I want you to strengthen our countermeasures against screen freezes.
lines.style: Direct, clipped delivery. A clear instruction with authority but not aggression. Slight pause after the opening. Business-like rhythm, no room for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品のプロトタイプを準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll have a new product prototype ready.
lines.style: Focused and affirming. Immediate agreement with quiet competence underneath. Steady pace, even delivery. Not rushing, not lingering—just professional clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、出版物のゲラを丁寧に校正しろ
lines.en: I need you to proofread our publications carefully. Precision matters.
lines.style: Measured direction. Slightly heavier emphasis on the request. Brief, economical phrasing. The tone of someone who's seen sloppy work before and won't tolerate it again.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。内野守備のような正確さで業務を進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll approach each task with the precision of a fielder—no missed details.
lines.style: Earnest and specific. A light metaphorical touch that shows he's thinking, not just nodding. Slightly more engaged than before. Steady, deliberate delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、地場産業との連携を強化しろ
lines.en: I want to strengthen our partnerships with local industries.
lines.style: Directive tone, slightly warmer than the first instructions. Still composed and clear, but with a hint of investment in the goal. A beat of clarity before moving on.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。からくり装置のような細工は避けます
lines.en: Understood. I'll keep our approach straightforward—no unnecessary complications.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment with a note of understanding. The metaphor lands lightly. Confident but not boastful. Ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のペンネームを尊重しろ
lines.en: And I want you to respect our staff's pen names and creative identities.
lines.style: Slightly softer than the prior directives. There's a subtle shift—this is personal, not just operational. Deliberate pacing. A moment of care underneath the authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中高生向け教育市場も検討します
lines.en: Yes. We should also look into the junior and senior high school education market.
lines.style: Thoughtful closure. Slightly longer pause before the response. Shows he's considered the implication and is adding value. Calm, measured, looking ahead.
